quests.title: Bad Workmanship, Worse Company
quests.text: I'd welcome a proper look at the old masonry, if Causeway Brigands and Aqueduct Bowmen would let our surveyors near it. Go by day to the {name:front_broken_causeway/wraithwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/wraithwood}, and defeat five of the brigands and bowmen lurking there. A dwarf should be able to criticise a crumbling arch in peace.
quests.lesson: The hard half of the Causeway: archers among the brigands.

quests.title: A Runesmith's Awkward Questions
quests.text: My runesmiths know this stamp: the old Copperfell counting-house pressed one like it into forged purses, but that was ink, and this is burned clean through the metal. Someone has scorched the same ring into the stones at {name:brandscar_cairn} {dir_from_giver:brandscar_cairn}; take a rubbing of it. Then bring me three Siege Bones from the Tollroad Skeletons in the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields}, which lie {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields}, after dark, so the smiths can see what keeps them on their feet.

objectives.label: Take a rubbing of the brand

quests.lesson: The top belt of the Causeway at night.

quests.title: Collection Ends Here
quests.text: The bones told the smiths what the coins do: {name:toll_taker_senn} pays his dead in that burnt coin, and it keeps them on the road. He works out of the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_camp} {dir_from_giver:front_broken_causeway/toll_camp}; defeat him and five of the Aqueduct Bowmen or Coal-Purse Factors guarding his take. His toll-box stands at {name:r20_anchor_078}; turn it out, because I want his accounts more than his apologies.
quests.lesson: Causeway climax and the main line's chapter 1 climax: a bowman camp, its named normal leader and Senn's toll-box.

quests.title: Senn's Accounts
quests.text: Senn's accounts say more than he did: he was paid to keep that road deadly, not merely to charge for it, and a Paymaster Chirr in The Skyglass Canopy promised him more. The pay bundle came wrapped in a requisition under a Throng seal, on very good paper, the kind a fortress keeps. Take all of it to the Warmaster at {name:pvp_fortress_accord}. I'd rather the accusations start with someone whose job it is.
quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 1 (last turn-in): the handoff from Archshadow Post back to the Warmaster.

quests.title: Group: No More Toll
quests.text: Whoever built {name:last_toll_construct} in the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields} {dir_from_giver:last_toll_construct} did solid work and left miserable instructions. The elite war construct is still enforcing its toll. Gather a group and destroy it; we can admire the craftsmanship once it stops trying to flatten you.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite; the route reaches 50 without it.

quests.title: Bounty: An Arrow Too Many
quests.text: Senn's Aqueduct Bowmen are still at work in the {name:front_broken_causeway/gallows_wood}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/gallows_wood}, despite the change in management. Defeat five there by day for a bounty. I can pay for another five twenty-five minutes after each turn-in; I've a budget for clearing the road and every intention of spending it.
quests.lesson: Repeatable hunting bounty, upper Causeway: close in on archers.

quests.title: Fit for Borin's Crew
quests.text: You've done work here that will hold, and Borin Splitbolt needs that sort of hand for Gravesalt Escarpment. Speak with him at Splitbolt Station in Stormvault Heights and pass on my report. He'll grumble that I should have sent you sooner; that's his welcome speech.
quests.lesson: Handoff from the Causeway to Gravesalt.

quests.title: No Shoring, No Sense
quests.text: Salt-Boring Weevils are tunnelling through the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/saltflats}, which lie {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/saltflats}, without a thought for what stands above them. Kill six there by day before another stretch gives way. Even my worst apprentice knew to brace a tunnel, and he once shored up his own beard.

quests.title: Rope with Opinions
quests.text: A line strung between trees ought to help a traveller find the path. In the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/bonewood}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/bonewood}, it helps Salt-Web Bonelurker Spiders find supper. Kill six of those spiders after dark; I'd like our crews to finish a night shift under their own power.
quests.lesson: Gravesalt entry by night, in the same outing.

quests.title: Something for the Mortar Crew
quests.text: The mortar crew has asked for Salt Chitin, and for once the request came without a lecture. Bring me three pieces from Salt-Boring Weevils on the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/blight_terraces}, which lie {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/blight_terraces}, by day. I'll keep them busy arguing over the mixing trough until you're back.
quests.lesson: The middle belt of Gravesalt by day.

quests.title: Leave the Graves Out of It
quests.text: Salt-Hex Bog Witches gather after dark in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}, counting salt over the graves. Our ancestors earned their rest, and so did whoever lies there. Kill six of those witches at night before their muttering wakes something we have to bury twice.
quests.lesson: Casters in a sparse swamp: close in fast.

quests.title: An Overdue Dismissal
quests.text: Last-Pay Archers still loose arrows from the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/saltroad_cliffs}, which lie {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/saltroad_cliffs}, every night. Defeat five there after dark so our road crews can work. Their paymaster got his money's worth; everyone else has been paying for it ever since.
quests.lesson: Archers on high ground at night.

quests.title: The Whitewall Dead
quests.text: Past the cliffs the salt has built the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/whitewall}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/whitewall}, and Last-Watch Mummies walk it by day as if they still had a post to keep. Put six of them down. A dwarf respects a long shift, but not one this long.
quests.lesson: The top belt of Gravesalt by day.

quests.title: The Last Watch Ends
quests.text: {name:watch_captain_huskell} still commands the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/ossuary_wood} {dir_from_giver:watch_captain_huskell}, and his Last-Watch Skeleton Raiders march his rounds every night on fresh pay. Defeat five of the raiders after dark, then the captain himself, and bring me the roll he calls them by. Somebody has to relieve that watch, and it may as well be you.
quests.lesson: Gravesalt climax: its named normal leader at the heart of the escarpment.

quests.title: Group: Nothing Left to Count
quests.text: {name:salt_counter_witch} keeps her own count out in the Gravesalt mires {dir_from_giver:salt_counter_witch}, and every soldier in it is an entry she means to spend. She's an elite and she bites back, so gather a group before you go. I'd like the next count in that mire to come out at nothing.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite; the route reaches 60 without it.

quests.title: Bounty: Keep the Night Shift Moving
quests.text: My crews keep finding fresh webs in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tombwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tombwood}. Kill five Salt-Web Bonelurker Spiders there at night and collect a bounty. The job is available again twenty-five minutes after each turn-in. I'd sooner budget for you than keep replacing workers' boots with the workers still in them.
quests.lesson: Repeatable hunting bounty, Gravesalt middle belt.

quests.title: Someone Who Came Back
quests.text: Huskell's roll is no muster list: the page is headed 'the Undertithe', and it holds soldiers of both armies, bought back onto duty with fresh branded pay. At the bottom, in new ink, stands Odren Vell; the coin collected its own clerk. Take the page to Eriath Boughwarden in Lethariel, whose people are watching The Skyglass Canopy. He'll need three graceful sentences to agree with me.
